items.title: Add enforce readiness diagnostics without blocking local workflows
items.context: Extend authority status/config output to show server URL, policy discovery, actor key availability, runner ID/session readiness, and explicit local/off fallback. Missing enforce prerequisites are warnings outside enforce runner commands.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice authority status --json` 看到 `mode:"off"`, `localWorkflowUsable:true`, `productionDone:false`, and missing enforce prerequisites listed as readiness warnings, not global blockers.

happy.desc: Off mode status says local workflow is usable and production authority is disabled.

edge.desc: Shadow/enforce with missing URL or actor key reports actionable readiness gaps without writing receipts.

adversarial.desc: No status/readiness path can claim productionDone or receiptVerified without verified receipt input.

items.title: Document and test paid-server fallback semantics
items.context: Update docs and smoke tests so users know local/off remains free/local, shadow is observational, enforce runner requires Python authority. Keep ordinary lifecycle gates local unless explicit receipt-backed enforcement is configured.
items.userSees: README/guide explain: `KOALA_AUTHORITY_MODE=off` is default local workflow; `shadow` observes; `enforce` runner requires `KOALA_AUTHORITY_URL` and actor key setup.

happy.desc: Docs include local/off, shadow, and enforce runner meanings plus commands to inspect status.

edge.desc: Docs do not imply paid/server authority is required for normal local story development.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not say local JSON or status output can satisfy production authority gates.
